channel.title: Court Cam
channel.desc: A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments. A man charged with Aggravated Stalking slams his head into an exit door during his bond hearing; a defendant gets off to a bad start with the judge when she shows up late for her virtual hearing; a man sees his bond revoked after cursing at the judge and leaving his hearing early; and more.
